data.comment:
# Play Notes by Hand

A switch plays one recorded note while the run plays live. Every step runs in the editor process, with no file, model or key.

**How it works:** "1 Note" is a Code node that writes one plucked note. "2 Trigger" sends a gate pulse each time its Trigger switch changes, and it sends its Note value as a pitch. Each pulse starts a voice of "3 Sampler" at that pitch. A note lasts longer than a click, so notes that you play quickly sound together. "4 Room" adds a reverb.

**Try this:** Start the run, then click the Trigger switch on "2 Trigger" for each note. Set Note to 7 for a fifth or to 12 for an octave, then click again. Set Mode on "3 Sampler" to gated and Length on "2 Trigger" to 0.5: each note then stops when the pulse ends.
